final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT s.zoneref, t.healtheval, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM grouped) SELECT g.zoneref, g.healtheval, g.avg_ratio, g.record_count, g.avg_ratio - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE g.avg_ratio > o.overall_avg ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
